ai_language_tip: Speak standard Vietnamese (vi); northern (Hà Nội) and southern (Sài Gòn) accents are both understood; use 'anh/chị/em' pronouns, not 'bạn', with shop staff; English only at hotels and tourist venues.
english_ok: sometimes — Common at hotels, international clinics and tourist areas of Hà Nội, HCMC, Đà Nẵng; rare at local eateries, garages, markets and government offices.
politeness: Friendly-polite: open 'Alô, chào anh/chị', use 'dạ' to acknowledge and 'ạ' at sentence end for politeness; avoid overly blunt phrasing; close with 'cảm ơn anh/chị'.
name_tip: Full names are family-middle-given (Nguyễn Văn An); people are addressed by the last word (given name) with anh/chị: 'anh An', 'chị Lan'; bookings usually go under given name + phone.
phone_tip: Mobile 10 digits like 09X 123 4567 or 03X 123 4567; Hà Nội landline 024 1234 5678, HCMC 028 1234 5678; the same mobile is usually the Zalo ID; read back in 3-3-4 groups.
time_tip: CRITICAL: '8 giờ kém 15' = 7:45 (kém = minus)! 'rưỡi' = half past ('7 rưỡi' = 7:30); add sáng/trưa/chiều/tối ('7 giờ tối' = 19:00); dates are day/month ('5/12' = 5 December).
number_tip: Say digits singly; 'lẻ' or 'linh' means zero inside numbers (105 = một trăm lẻ năm); 'mốt' = 1 after tens (21 = hai mốt); money in nghìn/k ('50k' = 50.000 đồng).
avoid_calling: Avoid the 11:30–13:30 lunch and nap break at offices and clinics, restaurant rush 11:00–12:30 and 18:00–20:00, calls after 21:00, and the week around Tết when most shops are shut.
closed_days: Government offices work Monday to Friday; many private companies also work Saturday morning (the labour code allows up to 48 hours a week); most shops and eateries open 7 days; nearly everything closes for several days around Tết and around 30/4–1/5 and 2/9.
booking_channels: Zalo messages dominate bookings with restaurants, salons, clinics and landlords; PasGo for dining, ShopeeFood/GrabFood for delivery, Grab/Xanh SM/Be for rides, Batdongsan.com.vn and Chợ Tốt for property.
voice_menu: Telcos (Viettel, Vinaphone, Mobifone), banks, EVN electricity and delivery firms use IVR menus; private hospitals have call centers ('tổng đài'); small shops answer directly.
callback_habits: Businesses usually reply and confirm through Zalo (same number as the phone); clinics and spas send Zalo or SMS reminders; tradesmen call back directly from a mobile.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 導覽、球場與密室多可 Zalo 或電話預約；熱門景點門票多上網買。

may_come_up.what: Tickets sold online only

sensitive_asked.what: Requires transfer to personal account to secure the slot

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 髮廊、美甲與 spa 多用 Zalo 或 Facebook 粉專訊息預約，電話也可；熱門 spa 週末需提前。

may_come_up.what: Deposit for long nail or hair treatments

sensitive_asked.what: Asks full prepayment to personal account before booking

usually_asked: Service (cắt, nhuộm, uốn, nail, gội đầu dưỡng sinh)

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期或取消多用 Zalo 即可；訂金在臨時取消時通常不退。

may_come_up.what: Deposit not refunded for late cancellation

sensitive_asked.what: Clinic asks CCCD number to find booking

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 私立醫院與診所（Vinmec、FV 等）有客服總機可預約；公立醫院多現場掛號排隊，部分可用 App 或 Zalo 預約。

may_come_up.what: Public hospital is first-come queue; book via app or arrive early
Private clinic asks to pay consultation fee in advance online

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CCCD (citizen ID) number, date of birth or health insurance number

usually_asked: Patient full name and year of birth

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信、銀行與電力客服有語音選單，帳戶事項須本人以 CCCD 驗證。

may_come_up.what: Third party cannot handle account without holder

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CCCD number, account number or OTP

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 行政手續多走國家公共服務入口網（dịch vụ công）；學校與幼兒園可電話詢問，週六下午與週日不接。

may_come_up.what: Procedure must be filed online or in person

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CCCD or child's personal ID number

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 冷氣清洗、水電、清潔多電話或 Zalo 叫；公寓社區需先向管理處登記，巷弄地址（hẻm）要說清楚。

may_come_up.what: Travel fee and per-unit price quoted
Building management requires worker registration

usually_asked: Full address with hẻm/alley, building, floor, room

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 連鎖飯店多經 Booking.com/Agoda，民宿與小旅館常用 Zalo 或電話；入住須出示護照或 CCCD 做住宿登記。

may_come_up.what: Passport or ID needed at check-in for residence registration
Deposit by transfer to secure the room on holidays

sensitive_asked.what: Asks passport or ID number in advance

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 詢問營業時間、春節（Tết）營業安排、能否刷卡或轉帳、有無汽車停車位，店家通常電話或 Zalo 直接回答。

may_come_up.what: Gives hours and says closed during Tết days
Car parking unavailable; motorbike parking only

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫與寵物美容多可電話或 Zalo 預約，週末較滿。

may_come_up.what: Extra fee for large dog or matted coat

sensitive_asked.what: Pet hotel asks full prepayment to personal account

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋與買房多看 Batdongsan.com.vn、Chợ Tốt，仲介與房東習慣 Zalo 約看房。

may_come_up.what: Asks to continue on Zalo
Requires 1–2 months deposit to reserve the apartment

sensitive_asked.what: Asks viewing or holding fee before seeing the unit

repair.before_dialing_zh: 機車與汽車修理行、家電維修多直接打電話；原廠保養（Toyota、VinFast 等）可電話預約。

may_come_up.what: Quotes a check fee before repair
Asks photos via Zalo

usually_asked: Vehicle or device model and plate number

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 越南人訂位常用 Zalo 或電話，週末與節日（聖誕、跨年、婦女節）熱門店需提早訂，大桌或包廂可能收訂金。

may_come_up.what: Deposit for private room or large party via bank transfer QR
Asks to send details via Zalo
Table held only 15–30 minutes

sensitive_asked.what: Asks bank account details for deposit refund

usually_asked: Indoor air-con, outdoor or private room (phòng riêng)

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 蛋糕店、花店與電器行常接受 Zalo 預訂；中秋月餅與節日花籃須提早訂並付訂金。

may_come_up.what: Deposit required for custom cake or flower basket

sensitive_asked.what: Requests full payment to unknown personal account

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 小吃與餐廳常可電話或 Zalo 點餐自取，外送多走 ShopeeFood、GrabFood、Be。

may_come_up.what: Delivery only through ShopeeFood/GrabFood
Pay by bank transfer QR at pickup

sensitive_asked.what: Requests prepayment to personal account for small order

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Viettel Post、GHN、GHTK、VNPost 多為總機語音選單或 App 追蹤；建議用官網、App 或 Zalo OA 查件。

may_come_up.what: Hotline routes to online tracking or Zalo official account

sensitive_asked.what: Asks OTP code to change delivery

transport.before_dialing_zh: 叫車以 Grab、Xanh SM、Be 為主；機場接送與包車可 Zalo 或電話預約。

may_come_up.what: Suggests booking through app
Extra charge for night, tolls or extra stops

sensitive_asked.what: Car rental asks ID or driving licence
